name: kahea
description: Deterministic HTTP and finite WebSocket planning, testing, and policy-gated execution for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Seal, test, and invoke APIs with exact grants
interface.longDescription: Kāhea turns API descriptions and captured requests into sealed plans, invokes only with exact capability grants, and returns typed, replayable evidence. Its bundled skill teaches agents to preserve that boundary; its local MCP server exposes inspect, plan, invoke, and explain.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this OpenAPI description and show the safest operation plan.
Run deterministic contract tests for this API operation.
Invoke this sealed plan with only its required grants.
